Iran rejects foreign role in Hormuz mine clearance, rules out US talks

Iran has stated it will not allow foreign involvement in clearing mines in the Strait of Hormuz. The country also indicated that immediate talks with the United States are unlikely. This comes as Iran reportedly increases its rhetoric about controlling the strategic waterway ahead of potential new negotiations with the US.
